summary.name: Coachify
summary.one_liner: Coachify is an AI fitness app that builds personalized workout plans, logs sets with progress feedback, and tracks nutrition.
use_cases: Build a personalized workout plan around goals and equipment
Log gym sets and see gains against past averages
Track calories, macros and steps in one dashboard
Follow progressive overload and rest timers during workouts
Ask an AI coach questions about form or nutrition
summary.what_it_does: Coachify is an AI personal trainer app that generates workout and nutrition plans from a short quiz about goals, experience and schedule. During workouts it logs each set, compares it against the user's average, and shows percentage gains, along with weekly calendars and streaks. It offers smart rest timers, 3D exercise visuals for 500+ exercises, and past logs and alternatives per exercise. Nutrition tracking covers calories, macros, steps and burned energy, with meal logging by text or photo. The page also describes an AI chat coach available at any time and progress reports showing strength trends.
notable: AI chat coach for form, plans and nutrition questions
Per-set feedback showing percentage gains versus average
Meal logging with photos and automatic step/calorie sync
caveats: Listed as paid in the source directory; the page itself shows no prices
Platforms are not named on the page beyond a 'download' mention, so app store availability is unclear
